name: formula-champion
description: WORKING champion weights for the deterministic formula policy (makeFormulaPolicy default: chain search + 1.5-ply lookahead + banking features). Strongest verified player.

provenance.method: CEM, RUN-SURVIVAL objective, two-stage eval, seeded from the prior champion. Adds the FORESIGHT package: 1.5-ply lookahead (best self follow-up − opponent reply), convex mana-affordability gradient (banking), Cestus-family hoard-aware spending.

promoteCheck.note: 3 independent fresh-seed sets vs prior champion (features-zeroed), all positive
promoteCheck.curve: post enemy-HP-curve steepening; champion ~40% / candidate ~43.5% avg run survival

provenance.notes: Deterministic evaluation pathway (CLAUDE.md pathway-dominance verdict). New weights: manaCloseness/lookaheadSelf/lookaheadOpp.
